# Meridian
Meridian is an independent crypto news publication covering DeFi, digital-asset markets, regulation, security, and the people building digital finance.
It serves readers who want clear, concise reporting with context behind market-moving events.
## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://aboutdefi.github.io/): Reverse-chronological crypto news and analysis.
- [About Meridian](https://aboutdefi.github.io/about/): Editorial focus and masthead information.
- Coverage emphasizes primary documents, protocol changes, market structure, and accountable reporting.
